name: 히스이

sources.title: 님블뉴런 공식 실험체 스킬: 모노호시자오 / 츠바메가에시

visual_review: 청록 포니테일·붉은 눈·검과 의상의 정체성을 유지했습니다. 긴 검 발도부터 첫/두 번째 베기·중앙 마무리·납도가 서로 다른 몸/검 방향으로 읽힙니다.
motion_summary: Hisui dark teal high ponytail, red eyes, black/white/red swordwoman outfit and long red-hilted katana from portrait. R draws very long Monohoshizao then its recast cuts twice and finishes through center. Animate ready sword low; reaching to scabbard; drawing long katana; blade held long diagonal; shoulders twist right; first horizontal red-white slash; reverse twist; second opposite diagonal slash; low center cutting thrust with three converging silver/red strokes; follow-through hair sweeping behind; sheathing; original idle. Keep same katana design, no duplicate swords appearing, proper two-handed grip where needed. Sharp focused eyes distinct from Nia. Deliberate three-hit sword choreography, no generic all-frame aura.
